title: Project sessions' full replies and questions come back to the Assistant

requirements.text: When a project session finishes a turn, its full final reply reaches the Assistant labelled with project and session, whether or not voice is on
requirements.check: cd app && swift test (relay case) + eye: tell a project something, its reply appears in the Assistant

requirements.text: A question a project agent asks the user (genlock ask user) reaches the Assistant, and the Assistant's answer goes back with genlock answer
Replies are not delivered twice, and the Assistant is not interrupted mid-turn: they queue until it is idle
assistantRule tells the Assistant these are agent reports, to relay them to the user and pass answers back with genlock tell
swift build, swift test and node tests/run.mjs pass
requirements.check: cd app && swift build && swift test; node tests/run.mjs

text: Found: today only voice summaries (channel say-*.json, takeMessages) reach the Assistant, via routeUpdates (AppModel ~L887), only with voice on and 2+ projects ready. Full replies need a new path: transcript last assistant message, or a hook writing it. Outbound already exists: genlock tell PROJECT --session (lib/overview.mjs cmdTell). Not started.
